title: Example: Pi Zero 2 W case
purpose: EXAMPLE product that exercises the drafting phase; the brief was written by the skill's author, not by the owner. A printed case that protects a Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W on a desk with its ports usable.

requirements.text: Holds a Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W (65 × 30 board, 4.2 tall, ports on one long edge)
Mini-HDMI and both micro-USB ports usable with the board in the case
Printable in PLA on an FDM printer without supports
Wall thickness, clearances and how the case closes
